text.en:
1680
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, Elpidio
Quirino, President of the Philippines, do hereby further
amend Executive Order No. 318, dated May 25, 1950, creat-
ing the Integrity Board, as amended so as to have said
body composed of the following:
Justico Luis P.
Justice Mariano H. de Joya
Honorable Jose P. Bengzon
Judge Pompeyo Diaz
Mrs. Pilar Hidalgo Lim
Dr. Jose A. de Jesus ..
... Executive Secretary
Done in the City of Manila, this Tth day of May, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-twe,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Presidert of the Philippines
•
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
